description: BEN - Generación de electricidad por fuente is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Industria, Energía y Minería. Se presenta la generación de energía eléctrica desagregada por fuente: fósil, hidro, biomasa, eólica y solar. Se incluye la electricidad entregada al Sistema Interconectado Nacional (SIN) así como también la electricidad de autoproducción que se consume directamente sin ser volcada al SIN. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Industria, Energía y Minería. Its tags are BEN, Balance, Balance Energético Nacional, Electricidad, Energía eléctrica. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML. The portal shows 2026-08-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
